title: Domain Propensity & Interoperability Scout: prioritized competitive map and research hypotheses
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Objective: produce a prioritized competitive map that surfaces domain-level propensity (which providers/models win for which verticals), interoperability gaps (API/format differences, quantization/variant compat), and a small set of falsifiable hypotheses we can validate with focused probes. Scope: 6 target verticals (finserv, healthcare, customer support, search/RAG, developer tools, knowledge bases). Deliverables: 1) a ranked matrix of provider-model-domain fit with confidence signals, 2) 6 short reconnaissance experiments (synthetic workloads + small field probes) and scripts, 3) a triage rubric for model substitution risk for customers. Approach: combine telemetry sampling (existing usage buckets), synthetic microbench harness (short prompts & few-shot tasks), and partner interviews. Trade-offs: narrow verticals to keep probes lightweight; prioritize observable latency+failure modes over exhaustive quality sweeps. Success metrics: actionable substitutions (>=3) surfaced for sales/SRE, validated hypotheses with sample size >=20 per probe, reproducible benchmark notebooks. Constraints: limited compute credits for wide-scale evals, legal/preproc constraints on customer-derived prompts. Artifacts will live in Confluence and a landscape repo; link to working doc and draft notebook below. Stakeholders: PM (Sofia), Research (Anya Gupta), Field Eng (Marco Li), Solutions Eng sales liaison (Priya Narang).
